# atlassian_organization_user (Data Source)

Searches all pages of an Atlassian organization directory and returns every matching user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_organization_user" "example" {
  organization_id = "your-organization-id"
  directory_id    = "your-directory-id"
  emails          = ["user@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) Directory ID used in the Organization API path.
- `organization_id` (String) Atlassian organization ID used in the Organization API path.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) Account IDs to match. Accepts 1 to 10 values.
- `account_status` (Set of String) Account lifecycle statuses to match: active, inactive, or closed.
- `claim_status` (String) Filter by claim status: managed or unmanaged.
- `directory_ids` (Set of String) Directory IDs to match. Accepts 1 to 10 values.
- `email_domains` (Set of String) Email domains to match. Accepts 1 to 10 values.
- `emails` (Set of String) Full email addresses to match exactly. Accepts 1 to 100 values and is mutually exclusive with search_term.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) Group IDs to match. Accepts 1 to 10 values.
- `membership_status` (Set of String) Organization membership statuses to match: active, suspended, or no_membership.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean) Filter by whether MFA is enabled.
- `resource_ids` (Set of String) Resource ARIs to match. Accepts 1 to 20 values.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) Atlassian role IDs to match. Accepts 1 to 10 API-supported values.
- `search_term` (String) Free-text display name or email search. Mutually exclusive with emails.
- `status` (Set of String) Composite user statuses to match. Accepts 1 to 4 API-supported values.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes Set) All users matching the configured filters. The set is empty when no users match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Unique Atlassian account ID.

- `added_to_org` (String) ISO-8601 time when the user was added to the organization.

- `department` (String) Department.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email address is verified.
- `job_title` (String) Job title.
- `location` (String) Location.
- `management_source` (String) How the account was added to the directory.
- `membership_status` (String) Organization membership status.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean) Whether MFA is enabled.
- `name` (String) Full name.
- `nickname` (String) Nickname.
- `organization` (String) Organization profile field.
- `picture` (String) Profile picture URL.
